Fork of [heroslender/lg-remote](https://github.com/heroslender/lg-remote) with extra features.

### What's new
- **Wake-on-LAN**: save the TV's MAC address in its Edit screen, then tap the offline TV in the device list to turn it on. The app connects once the TV is back.
- **Colored buttons**: red, green, yellow and blue keys at the bottom of the remote page.
- **More reliable connection**: automatic reconnect, a heartbeat that detects dead connections, and reconnecting when the app comes back or the phone's network changes.
- **Home button remap**: choose an app (such as a custom launcher) to open instead of the TV home screen, in the TV's Edit screen.
- **Hold to repeat** on the arrows, volume and channel buttons.
- **OK long press** (experimental): choose which key a long press on OK sends. A real "hold" of the key isn't supported by the TV's protocol, so this may not work in every app.

### Installing
Download the `.apk`, open it on your phone and allow installing from this source when asked. This build is signed with a temporary debug key, so if you already have another build of the app installed (including the original), uninstall it first. The same applies when updating to a later release: uninstall the old one first.
